recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: What did your partner first notice about you?
Who said I love you first?
What did you do on your first date?
Which song reminds them of you two?
What is their favorite memory of you two?
What did they text you first?
What was the first thing they bought you?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Our story edition: 8 questions about how you two started. Do you remember the same things?

Comment your score!
